intent: Generate alternate camera views using references, plus targeted projection edits for the overhead image
user_direction: Bryson loves the mountainside night campus with robot dogs. He requested three finished study images from multiple angles and inside the facility, keeping their spatial relationships consistent. During generation he added one view from directly above to help establish a common layout.

relative_spatial_convention.south: Downhill wall and dark gate; city beyond and below
relative_spatial_convention.west: Green-roof lab pavilion and parked autonomous-shuttle court
relative_spatial_convention.center: Water garden; two branching photovoltaic canopies on west bank
relative_spatial_convention.east: Lower greenhouse and instrumented planting beds

shared_initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: realistic video game environment concept, a spatially consistent alternate camera view within an EXISTING campus.
Input Image 1 is the authoritative site and visual reference: the selected terraced mountainside OpenBrain research park at night, with robot-dog patrols. Change the CAMERA POSITION to the shot brief; reconstruct the SAME facility. Do not design a new campus, mirror its layout, add a second main headquarters, change the architectural family, flatten the terrain or change the time/exposure.

Fixed site relationships (directions are a production convention for this study):
NORTH / uphill: the dry rocky California mountain and massive broad white/black principal building at the highest terrace, facing downhill/south, with the existing friendly black loop emblem on its broad white facade and a long glazed gallery across its lower front. Keep its stepped wings and green roofs.
SOUTH / downhill: the enclosed lower boundary, a smooth off-white privacy/retaining wall with dark coping and the closed dark service gate, slightly east of the central garden. The distant low city spreads BELOW this boundary.
CENTER: the terraced water garden. A shallow elongated reflecting basin/channel runs approximately uphill–downhill, edged by planted beds and pedestrian paths. Immediately WEST of the water sit the SAME TWO adjacent branching white photovoltaic shade structures, with broad dark blue rectangular solar roofs over seating. They stay on the same bank in every view.
WEST: the two-story white/black green-roof lab pavilion with a smaller loop emblem. The autonomy/service courtyard below it has the same compact parked white autonomous shuttle, small service robot and low charging/scanning posts.
EAST / southeast: the lower dark-framed glass greenhouse and instrumented plant research beds. A white/black lab terrace rises behind it. Its location must not exchange with the vehicle court.
Visible stairs, planted retaining tiers and supported glazed walkways connect lower gate level, central garden level and upper headquarters/gallery level. Use plausible matched elevations and human scale. Layout detail hidden by the original camera can be reasonably resolved, but do not move the shared anchors.

Visual constants: pristine white panels and concrete, black-framed glass, sparse tiny red security indicators, maintained green roof lawns, carefully engineered California planting, water, practical cameras/readers/scanners/experiment equipment. Grounded near-future modern architecture. Calm technological paradise with unobtrusive AI surveillance. Clean realistic photographic / architectural visualization finish with believable materials and crisp details, no oily brushwork or grime.

Lighting and occupancy: preserve the master's quiet NIGHT exposure, cool ambient skylight with readable shadow midtones and small selective warm pools at some entrances/landings. Most lab windows, decorative fixtures and entire path sections are unlit. No daytime, sunset, brighter earlier evening, uniformly glowing landscape or pitch-black unreadability. Most places are empty; only sparse security where the shot requests it. No scientists, commuters or crowds at this hour.

Guard hardware if visible: ordinary white work shirt, dark trousers, practical black shoes and belt, no armor. Sporty wraparound augmented reality glasses with thick electronic temples, uncovered hair, discreet comms and a visible wire to a belt compute puck. Robot dogs are compact white/black Spot-like industrial quadrupeds with four clearly jointed mechanical legs, rubber feet and optical sensors; small red status lights. They patrol autonomously beside guards without leashes. No living dogs or animal-like robot anatomy.

No explicit text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, real logos, labels, captions, license characters, watermark or game interface. Preserve only the source's simple friendly loop emblem as a shape. No humanoid robots, holograms, scan beams, mechs, weapons display, fantasy forms or impossible floating architecture.

Output: one full-bleed landscape image approximately 16:9, a single cohesive scene without inset views, collage, border or caption. This is one of a three-view study; correct positions of shared landmarks are essential.
